# STR Booster

> STR Booster builds custom AI growth systems for short-term rental owners, co-hosts and property managers: AI agents for marketing, revenue management and sales, direct bookings and guest service, set up and supported so the owner stays in control. STR Booster is a division of Green Door Hotel Inc., founded by David Anthony Scott.

## About

- [Homepage](https://strbooster.com/): the four systems (marketing agents, revenue management and sales, direct booking systems, guest concierge), how engagements work and the founder.
- [How we work](https://strbooster.com/our-approach): discovery, build and ongoing support.
- [Book a discovery call](https://strbooster.com/get-expert-help): 30-minute call to scope the work. Pricing is agreed on this call.

## Services

- [AI agents and automation](https://strbooster.com/growth-services): marketing, social media, enquiry and sales, guest support and operations agents.
- [Revenue management](https://strbooster.com/revenue-management): pricing, minimum stays, seasonal strategy and channel mix.
- [Listing optimization](https://strbooster.com/listing-optimization): ideal-guest positioning, listing copy and photo strategy.
- [Technology and automation](https://strbooster.com/technology-automation): PMS, CRM and AI workflow setup.
- [Websites and booking funnels](https://strbooster.com/websites-funnels): direct booking websites, lead capture and follow-up.

- [Guest Intel](https://strbooster.com/guest-intel): identify a rental's ideal guest.
- [52Rev](https://strbooster.com/52rev): weekly revenue marketing planning (beta).
